instruction: Please help change GIMP's default interpolation method to 'None' (Fastest).

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's default interpolation method to 'None' via Edit > Preferences > Tool Options. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (interpolation-type none) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts GIMP config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric function correctly receives rule parameter directly (not expected.get('rules')) - proper handling of type='rule'
Metric parsing logic correctly handles S-expression format (key value) and checks interpolation-type setting
Expected value 'none' for interpolation-type matches GIMP's config format
Postconfig appropriately quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting (interpolation-type none) that the instruction requires
